KI-Automatisierung

Alle Prompts aus dem Seedance 2.5 Test

Hier findest du alle Videos und Prompts zu den Beispielen aus dem Video, in derselben Reihenfolge. 47 Generierungen aus acht Disziplinen, jede mit dem vollständigen Prompt zum Kopieren, den Referenzdateien und den Einstellungen.

Video ansehen Zur Community

Die Prompts sind auf Englisch, auch für deutsche Sprachausgabe. Was gesprochen wird, steht wörtlich in Anführungszeichen, in der jeweiligen Sprache und in Originalschrift.

Geschrieben hat sie Claude über die Higgsfield-CLI. Wie das Setup aussieht, siehst du im Video ab Minute 41.

Prompt 
Close-up of an emotional monologue. The woman in <<<image_1>>> sits at a wooden dining table in the dimly lit, warm wooden kitchen of <<<image_2>>>—wooden cabinets, deeply blurred bowls, plates, and storage shelves behind her, night outside the window. There are no visible light sources in the frame—no chandeliers, lamps, lighting equipment, or fixtures—only the light itself and how it falls on her face are visible; all light sources are outside the frame. The entire film is shot in a single, continuous long take, without any editing, transitions, or camera changes—the same uninterrupted camera from beginning to end. She remains silent throughout, not uttering a single word—the entire emotion is conveyed solely through facial expressions and eye contact. All emotions shift rapidly, quickly transitioning from one to the next, each stage brief—the performance swiftly glides through each emotional phase in a tight rhythm. Camera: The camera position is fixed in place, but it presents the texture of handheld shooting—vivid handheld tremors, slight shaking and vibrations, the lens drifting almost imperceptibly left and right, breathing with the scene. The camera consistently focuses on her face, a close-up, keeping her centered and within the frame—only the subtle hand-held movement around her creates tension. This trembling, intimate feel builds tension, amplifying the emotional outburst. The light moves in circles around her, an invisible beam smoothly circling her along its trajectory, the illumination shifting with each stage: Stage 1 (Fast) – Suppressing bitterness. Her gaze is lowered, tears welling, her lower lip trembling, her chin furrowed, her breathing labored, her lips pressed tightly together. Lighting: Directly facing her, illuminating her entire face evenly and softly from the front, warm spots of light falling on her face, the surrounding background fading into warm darkness. Stage 2 (Fast) – Tears. Tears stream down her cheeks, she abruptly looks up, blinking to force the tears back, quickly wiping her eyes with the back of her hand, her eyes bright and red. Lighting: Shifts to her right side—now only the right half of her face is illuminated, the left half sinking into shadow, a soft, flowing shadow spreading across her face. Stage 3 (Fast) – A burst of laughter. A silent, hysterical laugh bursts forth through her tears, a mixture of sobs and laughter, her head shaking, her expression shifting from pain to relief. The lighting: continues to move behind her—her entire face sinks into shadow, the light coming from behind, the harsh backlight outlining her head with bright edges, illuminating her ears, cheekbones, and wispy strands of hair, leaving her face mostly dark, almost a silhouette with luminous edges. Fourth Stage (Climax)—Breakdown and Relief. She slams her hand on the table—the instant she strikes, the light suddenly blazes, illuminating her entire body. The lighting during the table slam: a strong, direct beam of light shines directly on her, bright, even light flooding in from all sides, clearly overexposed, shadows disappear, her face completely exposed and submerged in light. She then leans back in her chair, arms crossed, exhales a short breath, her eyes resolute, relieved. Fifth Stage (Ending)—The light shifts to candlelight. Lighting: Everything goes dark, leaving only the warm, flickering candlelight from off-screen sources (the candles themselves and any other light fixtures are not in the frame)—the warm, dancing light moves and flickers across faces, casting deep, soft shadows, with points of light dancing in the eyes. The lighting changes rapidly, but always smoothly—not abrupt cuts, nor flashes (except for the sudden, intense flash when the table is slammed), but rather the light source moves smoothly in circles, allowing the eye time to clearly see and understand each type of light before it transitions to the next; the intensity increases layer by layer with each stage. All of this happens without a single cut or splicing, within the same continuous long take: only the lighting changes, the camera remains vibrant and continuous. Close-up shots, anamorphic widescreen lenses, oval bokeh, shallow depth of field, no lens flare, no horizontal flare, no lens flare. Slight film grain, cinematic color grading. 8K. Audio: No music, no dialogue, only sound effects—intermittent breathing, sobbing, sniffling, a silent, nervous laugh with a breathy sound, the sound of slamming a table, the creaking of a chair, and slight crackling sounds.

Prompt 
A single unbroken close-up, no cuts, 20 seconds. Shallow depth of field, soft window light from the left, plain grey wall behind.
A woman in her late thirties sits at a kitchen table holding a phone to her ear. She listens and does not speak.
0-5s: calm, slightly impatient. Her eyes move around the room, a small polite half-smile.
5-9s: the smile fades. Her eyes stop moving and fix on one point. She swallows once.
9-14s: she closes her eyes for a moment, her chin tightens, she breathes in slowly through her nose. Her eyes become wet but no tear falls.
14-20s: she opens her eyes, exhales, wipes under one eye with the back of her hand and says quietly in German: "Okay. Ich komme."
The camera stays completely still for the whole take.
Audio: faint room tone, her breathing, a muffled voice on the phone. No music.

Referenzen im Prompt, 2 Bilder
Prompt 
Scene: Massive seaside Latin music festival, sunny summer afternoon — azure sky, turquoise sea, palm silhouettes on the horizon, 100,000+ spectators in bright colors stretching to the coastline. A male and female reggaeton singer perform on a giant tropical main stage. Multi-shot, fast-paced, hard-cut sequence emphasizing epic scale and summer heat.

Reference Locks:

Female singer (<<<image_2>>>): Long sun-lit deep caramel curls, bronze skin, large gold hoops, bright orange satin halter top, white low-waist cargo pants with gold chain belt, layered gold coin-pendant necklace, gold bracelets/waist chain, black wired mic. 100% match to reference.
Male singer (<<<image_1>>>): Short dark hair, faded sideburns, trimmed beard, open turquoise tropical-print silk shirt over white vest, beige linen wide-leg trousers with woven belt, matching gold coin necklace, gold watch/ring, amber sunglasses, black mic. 100% match to reference.

Location: Multi-layered steel tower stage with tropical foliage, reflective steel frame. Central LED screen (~30m) shows bright abstract tropical colors (orange/turquoise/sunset pink); two secondary LED towers flank it. Extended platform runs into the crowd. Foreground: platform, CO2 jets, ribbon cannons. Midground: performers. Background: LED wall, blue sky, distant sea/palms. Fan-shaped crowd in bright summer clothing waving hats, towels, flags.

First Frame: High-speed FPV shot skimming over the crowd toward the stage — no static or slow-motion buildup. Female singer stage-left, male stage-right, both at the platform's end, facing the crowd, moving to the reggae beat.

Format: Hard cuts only, no fades/dissolves, real-time speed throughout.

Shot 1 — Explosive Opening: FPV (107°) rockets over the crowd's heads toward the stage, passing hats and towels, sun flaring on the lens. As it reaches the singers, CO2 jets erupt in white plumes and orange/turquoise smoke grenades burst simultaneously.
Hard Cut
Shot 2 — Female Close-up: 29° portrait — she sings into the mic, fierce gaze at camera, curls whipping in the sea breeze, jewelry glinting, hips swaying against a soft-focus crowd and smoke backdrop.
Hard Cut
Shot 3 — Epic Reverse: 84° wide, high angle from behind both singers — arms raised, backs to camera, facing the endless crowd, flags waving, blue sky, shimmering sea beyond.
Hard Cut
Shot 4 — Male Close-up: 29° — he sings one-handed on the mic, shirt fluttering with highlights, other hand waving confidently to the crowd, relaxed smile.
Hard Cut
Shot 5 — Duet Dance: 47° medium shot from the platform front — the two face each other, dancing in sync, sharp sunlit shadows, camera panning gently with the beat.
Hard Cut
Shot 6 — Aerial Surround: Drone (107°) arcs around the full stage tower — sunlight, vapor columns, colored smoke, the crowd, and the turquoise sea beyond.
Hard Cut
Shot 7 — Crowd Interlude: Handheld 47° through the audience — people singing, jumping, riding shoulders with flags; water-spray guns catch golden light with slight flare.
Hard Cut
Shot 8 — Climax: 107° frontal wide — singers back-to-back center-stage, arms raised, as golden ribbon cannons fire CO2 columns skyward; gold/orange confetti fills the frame against blue sky, drifting down over the crowd.
Hard Cut
Shot 9 — Closing: Rapid pull-back to super-high aerial view — full stage, falling confetti, the colorful crowd to the coastline, turquoise sea, swaying palms.

Physics: Realistic weight in all movement — heel strikes, weight shifts, hip inertia in dance; delayed inertial swing in hair and chains; silk sways with wind/motion; flags and towels flutter; confetti falls under gravity, dispersed by breeze; CO2 disperses quickly; water follows parabolic arcs; mic cables drag with movement. No floating or teleporting figures.

Lighting: Intense late-midday tropical sun from upper right, sharp defined shadows. LED screen adds orange-cyan ambient glow against sunlight. CO2/confetti catch bright highlights; sea shimmers; sky is deep clear blue. Exposure keyed to sunlight — bright, not blown out; bronzed skin glowing. Saturated, vibrant color, sharp subjects, creamy blurred backgrounds — top-tier daytime festival look.

Audio: High-energy reggae — dembow beat, heavy bass, Latin percussion syncopation, 100,000-person cheers/sing-along, CO2 hiss, confetti cannon bursts. Singers perform in sync with the music; no dialogue, no subtitles.

Positive Lock: Only the two named singers appear on stage — no other performers or dancers. Faces, hair, clothing, and accessories 100% locked to reference images throughout, no drift. No brand logos, printed text, or cross ornaments. No on-screen text, logos, watermarks, or UI elements.
